## Details

<a id="text_ptrs"></a>
### [`text_ptrs`](../../../../src/text/texts.asm#L6) `$B90E-$B93D`

*data*

Pointers to the 24 texts. The text printer at $9173 draws text $80+n from entry n.

- **Read by:** [`clear_fighter_score`](../fighter/fighter_init.md#clear_fighter_score), [`show_counter`](../score/status_line.md#show_counter), [`show_energy_scores`](../score/status_line.md#show_energy_scores), [`add_time_bonus`](../score/time_bonus.md#add_time_bonus), [`add_hit_score`](../combat/hits.md#add_hit_score), [`print_text`](print_text.md#print_text)

<a id="text_zeros"></a>
### [`text_zeros`](../../../../src/text/texts.asm#L14) `$B93E-$B944`

*data*

Text format: column, row, colour byte, then characters. $0d starts a new line with 3 new header bytes. The colour byte goes to screen RAM (high nibble) and colour RAM (low nibble). Other characters than A-Z and text_special_chars end the text. Text 0: "000" at row 22. No code prints text 0.

- **Entry of:** [`text_ptrs`](../../tables.md#text_ptrs)

<a id="text_version"></a>
### [`text_version`](../../../../src/text/texts.asm#L17) `$B945-$B952`

*data*

Text 1: the version "V 05 05 87". CTRL+V shows it.

- **Entry of:** [`text_ptrs`](../../tables.md#text_ptrs)

### [`text_1plr`](../../../../src/text/texts.asm#L21) `$B953-$B95A`

### [`text_your_end`](../../../../src/text/texts.asm#L42) `$B98D-$B9A1`

<a id="text_thanks"></a>

*data*

Text 10: "THANKS BIG BOY". The final stage of part 2 prints it. No code of part 1 prints it.

<a id="text_energy_00"></a>
### [`text_energy_00`](../../../../src/text/texts.asm#L52) `$B9B4-$B9C7`

*data*

Texts 11-23: the energy display for energy 0-12, 20 bytes each. Each has 2 lines of 6 characters. "(" and ")" draw the energy units. $82d4 writes the column of the fighter into byte 0 and byte 10.

- **Entry of:** [`text_ptrs`](../../tables.md#text_ptrs)
